View 1333 West 11th Avenue, Vancouver, BC V6H 0A4, CA rent availability, including the monthly rent price, and browse photos of this 2 beds, 2 baths, 1,450 sqft apartment. 1333 West 11th Avenue, Vancouver, BC V6H 0A4, CA offers 2 bedroom apartments for rent or lease. There is currently 1 unit listed for rent at 1333 West 11th Avenue, Vancouver, BC V6H 0A4, CA.
Experience elevated city living in this exceptional 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom plus den residence at 1502-1333 West 11th Avenue. Offering an expansive 1,450 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space, this home boasts breathtaking panoramic views of the city, mountains, and water through floor to-ceiling windows that flood the interior with natural light. The spacious open-concept layout features generous living and dining areas, a well-appointed kitchen with premium appliances, and a versatile den perfect for a home office. The primary suite offers a walk-in closet and a luxurious ensuite, while the second bedroom provides excellent privacy for family or guests. Enjoy spectacular sunsets from your private balcony and the convenience of living in Vancouver’s desirable Fairview neighborhood, just moments from South Granville, Granville Island, boutique shopping, renowned restaurants, parks, transit, and Downtown Vancouver. This is an exceptional opportunity to enjoy spacious luxury living with unforgettable views.  HOME FEATURESSpacious 1,450 sq. ft. floor plan with 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and a versatile den ideal for a home office. Spectacular panoramic views of the city, mountains, and water from oversized windows and the private balcony. Bright open-concept living and dining areas with abundant natural light and plenty of room for entertaining. Well-appointed gourmet kitchen featuring quality appliances, ample cabinetry, and generous counter space. Private primary suite with a walk-in closet, spa-inspired ensuite, and excellent separation from the second bedroom.
